title: Past Race — Tokyo Marathon 2026 results
claims: The 2026 marathon had 38,472 participants and 37,268 finishers, a 96.9% finish rate.
Total participation was 38,773 including 301 in the 10.7 km race; total finishers were 37,567 including 299 in the 10.7 km race.
The men's marathon was won by Tadese Takele of Ethiopia in 2:03:37.
The women's marathon was won by Brigid Kosgei of Kenya in 2:14:29, a new course record.
The men's wheelchair marathon was won by Marcel Hug of Switzerland in 1:21:09.
The women's wheelchair marathon was won by Catherine Debrunner of Switzerland in 1:37:15.

Among marathon finishers, 2,070 (5.6%) finished under 3 hours, 9,951 (26.7%) under 4 hours, 11,389 (30.6%) under 5 hours, 8,858 (23.8%) under 6 hours and 4,967 (13.3%) under 7 hours, excluding the wheelchair marathon.
The marathon gender ratio was 73.78% men, 26.11% women and 0.11% non-binary.
